name: Trefle
tagline: Plant species encyclopedia with taxonomy and distribution data
description: Trefle is a plant species encyclopedia API providing taxonomic data, growth habits, and geographic distribution for plants. It enables developers to search and retrieve structured botanical information for gardening, agriculture, and environmental applications.

auth.details: API token via query parameter token=YOUR_API_KEY or Authorization header; free self-serve signup required

use_cases: look up plant species by scientific or common name
get plant taxonomy genus and family for a species
retrieve growth habit and distribution data for a plant
search plants by filters for gardening apps
